images.note: Real screenshot from dbt's own official documentation, showing the dbt Cloud Studio IDE: the file explorer (a real dbt project structure — models/marts, macros, dbt_packages), a model's compiled SQL with a ref() call, and the Lineage tab rendering the actual DAG (source table -> staging model -> marts model).

imageNote: Found via curl on docs.getdbt.com — confirmed this site is NOT JS-rendered (unlike GitHub/Microsoft docs), a plain curl reveals real image paths directly in the HTML, though as relative paths (src="/img/docs/...") that need the https://docs.getdbt.com origin prepended, not as absolute URLs. This is the same 'curl-friendly' pattern as quickstarts.snowflake.com and help.tableau.com, distinct from the JS-rendered gotcha on docs.github.com/support.microsoft.com.
